Harel Birenstock, son of Yonat and Shlomo, was born on the 21st of Tishrei 5752 (29 September 1991) and grew up in Neve Daniel. He has four siblings: Kena, Assaf, Matan and Ateret.

Harel married Eliya, and they had four children: Uri, Gefen, Ma'ayan and Ziv.

On 16 February 2024 he enlisted in the reserves and served in the Infantry Corps.

Major Harel Birenstock fell in battle on the 22nd of Menachem Av 5786 (5 August 2026), at the age of thirty-four. He was laid to rest in the Mount Herzl Military Cemetery. He is survived by his wife, his children, his parents and his siblings.
